At the clinic

  1. Start setup as usual: double-click the Start file, or run python3 setup.py.
  2. When it asks for the setup code, paste this line.
  3. Setup does the rest: the installation ID, money setting, license, palette and clinic name{{ ', and the secrets' if has_secrets }}.

Or all in one command:

python3 setup.py --setup-code '…the code above…'

On a computer without Docker, add --db-mode native --database-url … (docs/NATIVE_POSTGRESQL.md).
